Axiom:
The same durable-fact rule holds for the behavioural `sdd-code-review` half of the group hook: a group is not "reviewed" until the CLI has recorded ONE `SDD_REVIEW_RECEIPT` on the owning spec. A skipped behavioural review is at least as dangerous as a skipped audit, so it leaves the same kind of receipt — and only the ran+verdict FACT, never the findings (findings route per `AX_EPHEMERAL_OUTPUT`).
After the group audit passes and the read-only `sdd-code-review` returns, the execute orchestrator — never the review worker — runs `sdd-log review-receipt `. The CLI re-resolves the group, refuses unless every member is `[x] DONE`, binds to the reviewed git ref, and writes the CLI-owned block atomically on the owning spec. `sdd-check` re-derives the group and emits `SDD_GROUP_REVIEW_MISSING` when a complete group has no valid, non-stale review receipt; a reopen invalidates it until re-review. This is a second group invariant, distinct from `AX_VERIFICATION_BEFORE_HANDOFF` (which stays the per-phase impl/test receipt and is unchanged).
